load_lora_model: load a LoRA model into a vLLM model runner with config and device
set_active_loras: set active LoRA adapters for an input batch with scheduled and sampled tokens
maybe_setup_dummy_loras: setup dummy LoRA adapters for capture or warmup with optional cleanup
maybe_select_dummy_loras: select dummy LoRA mappings for cudagraph capture with configurable active count
maybe_dummy_run_with_lora: run a dummy inference pass with LoRA adapters for kernel capture or warmup
